executive_summary.text: Amber combines strong reported growth and operating scale with material balance-sheet exposure, while its provisional portfolio weight makes the deterministic reduction subject to human review.

stance_and_action_explanation.text: The frozen engine records a SELL investment stance but a REVIEW_REQUIRED portfolio action because the proposed reduction depends materially on provisional holdings rather than verified live positions.

investment_thesis.text: FY26 revenue of INR 12,186 crore, operating EBITDA of INR 970 crore, and reported year-on-year revenue growth of 22% support the view that the business has meaningful operating scale and growth.

supporting_evidence.text: The supplied research includes an analyst estimate of more than 40% FY27 electronics revenue growth and management guidance for 13–15% RAC growth outperformance.

counter_evidence_and_risks.text: Borrowings of INR 2,306 crore substantially exceed cash and cash equivalents of INR 231 crore, and the supplied research highlights a sharp increase in period-end working-capital days.

valuation_scenario_explanation.text: The frozen scenarios start from the validated 8 September 2026 adjusted close and use FY26 revenue and operating EBITDA as the operating anchors; their values remain model assumptions rather than analyst targets.

portfolio_sizing_explanation.text: The target exposure is lower than the working current exposure because the engine combines the company view with balance-sheet risk and concentration controls; the working exposure remains an unverified proxy.

missing_information_and_limitations.text: Reported PAT of INR 226 crore and adjusted PAT of INR 338 crore differ by definition, while a verified diluted share count and independently reconstructed enterprise value remain unavailable.

what_would_change_the_decision.text: The view would need reassessment if electronics or RAC growth expectations weakened, or if leverage and cash conversion deteriorated materially.

human_review_explanation.text: Human review is required before acting because the portfolio quantities are provisional even though the decision-date market observation is validated.
